Hi Lisa / Acme procurement team —

Thanks again for the time on the demo yesterday. As we approach your internal close window, the Redwood team is consolidating a concise risk matrix and a set of mandatory next actions so your procurement and finance teams can complete approval within 48 hours.

Attached is a snapshot of the pipeline items we believe are in-scope for this quarter (acme_pipeline_risk_matrix_v3.xlsx) and the current SOW draft. My ask: can you confirm the intended procurement signatory and the date you need the final SOW by?

Key actions for Acme to unblock a July close:
- Confirm signatory (name + email)
- Accept payment terms (Net 30 / Net 45) or propose alternate
- Provide any required vendor paperwork for credit checks

We'll run a short internal sweep and provide a one-page ‘traffic light’ of items that could delay close. Marcus / Lauren / Ben — I need your updates by 2:00 PM PT today on status, outstanding approvals, and any gating legal items.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
